user.title: Hildebrand Glow Account
user.description: Enter your Hildebrand Bright app credentials.

select_entity.title: Select Your Meter
select_entity.description: Select the Bright meter site you want this Home Assistant integration to monitor.

tariff.title: Energy Tariff Configuration
tariff.description: Enter your energy tariff rates. These can be changed later.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Glowmarkt API.
error.no_resources: No smart meter resources found for this location.

abort.already_configured: This account and meter site are already configured.

settings.title: Tariff and polling settings
settings.description: Change fallback tariff values and API polling intervals. Polling below 5 minutes is blocked to protect the Glowmarkt API.

reset_history.title: Reset imported history
reset_history.description: Clear Hildebrand Glow's imported statistics and local backfill/tariff cache for this meter site, then rebuild them from Glow. Your credentials, entities, dashboards and unrelated Home Assistant history are not removed. Use this when imported history needs to be rebuilt or repaired.

error.reset_failed: The Hildebrand history reset failed. Your existing configuration has been preserved.
error.reload_failed: History was reset, but the integration could not be loaded again. Check the logs and reload the integration from Settings.

abort.reset_complete: Reset complete. {count} Hildebrand statistic IDs were cleared and the integration has restarted a clean backfill.
